comment: Overlay for sterile MOD exports (extends public_export_config.json). Public only: generic gates plus mod-tree shape (excludes, workflow inventory, binary hashes, reviewed fixture values). Literal private scrub rules live in the excluded private policy.
_note_review: Review F2: opaque-gate values are tree-declared Java identifiers (network packet class names, mixin/test/fixture names, hex long literals, vector path fragments), public mod pins, oracle fixture keys and doc result ids; email values are a public font pin, the Adoptium distribution id, animation-at-frame test data, a shell placeholder and one test fixture; root paths are model-node prose in fixtures and review docs; the single app-suffix value is a dev-rig jar name; that gate is path-scoped to one static audit doc. Every allow_exact value is U-escaped mid-token: the raw overlay file is itself scanned by the workspace export, so the escape keeps the file self-clean while decoding to the exact value. Banned-literal residue needed no overlay knob: old-organization doc links were rewritten to the public organization or neutralized to ids, owner-machine paths were made portable or dropped, review snapshots with player data and generated content-hash fixture manifests are excluded, and four ordinary words are reviewed path-scoped words in the private policy. Do not add new values without re-running the export.
